Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

About Respond.io

Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, Technical Customer Support are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be the go-to resource for our valued customers to obtain clarification when needed, provide best solution, and support any technical matters. In this role, your main priority is to drive excellent support and maintain customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality support to customers of our SaaS product
  • Communicate and respond to varied technical business solutions to customers in a team environment, using our shared inbox tool to assist with customer inquiries
  • Resolve customer inquiries in a timely manner using full understanding of the product value, functions, features, and customer’s business needs
  • Monitor common customer questions/concerns and partner with cross-functional teams to suggest solutions
  • Empower customers to self-serve and help users navigate our on-demand success resources
  • Work collaboratively across teams — Customer, Marketing, Product, and Tech — to solve complex problems
  • Provide customer support via multiple channels including chat, and video calls


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Customer Support role preferably in a SaaS or IT company
  • Experience in at least one of the following : API integrations, WhatsApp API, or Agentic AI
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English, and the proven ability to understand customer’s inquiries
  • Ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing
  • Ability to dig deeper to uncover customer’s true objectives
  • High level of empathy - it’s important for our Customer Support Associate to be a good person to peers and customers
  • Able to work in a fixed shift
  • Team-oriented mindset with a “thirst for more” attitude — always eager to learn, improve, and take on new challenges


Here's What's In For You

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like Talent Shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Crypto Investment Associate
description:
About the Role

Crypto Mining & Money is looking for a Crypto Investment Associate to support analysis, monitoring and evaluation of digital asset investment opportunities across the global crypto market.

This role focuses on researching emerging crypto projects, tracking market developments and helping identify promising investment opportunities across blockchain ecosystems. You will analyze token models, market trends and sector developments while supporting internal discussions around digital asset investments.

The position is suited for candidates who actively follow crypto markets and have practical exposure to cryptocurrency investing.

Responsibilities
  • Research cryptocurrency projects, tokens and blockchain ecosystems.
  • Monitor crypto market trends and sector developments.
  • Analyze token economics and project fundamentals.
  • Prepare structured research summaries and market insights.
  • Track performance of digital assets and investment opportunities.
  • Support evaluation of new crypto investment ideas.
  • Maintain organized research documentation.
Requirements
  • Strong interest in cryptocurrency markets and digital asset investing.
  • Experience researching or analyzing crypto projects.
  • Familiarity with DeFi, Web3 or blockchain ecosystems.
  • Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
  • Ability to monitor and interpret crypto market trends.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.
Compensation

Base Salary: USD 95,000 – 125,000 per year

Token Allocation: Performance-based token incentives linked to investment outcomes

Legacy: Long-term digital asset investment role within a growing crypto ecosystem

title: Data Analyst
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Data Analyst


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Help Fraud Deflect turn data into clear, reliable insights across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, and operational performance. The focus is working within the current stack to improve reporting, analysis, data quality, and decision-making, not rebuilding everything from scratch.


Responsibilities

  • Own reporting and analysis for core business datasets.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking.
  • Write and optimize SQL for analysis, reporting, and data validation.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and merchant trends to identify risks, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Investigate anomalies, data issues, and performance changes across key metrics.
  • Partner with engineering, product, operations, and leadership to answer business questions with data.
  • Work with existing pipelines and datasets to improve trust, consistency, and usability of data.
  • Use Python for analysis, validation, and lightweight automation where needed.
  • Support data quality efforts by identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and edge cases in source data.
  • Create clear visualizations and communicate findings in a practical, business-friendly way.
  • Work within the current stack (MySQL, AWS, Airflow; ClickHouse is a plus).


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports.
  • Ability to translate business questions into clear analysis.
  • Experience working with production data and validating data quality.
  • Python proficiency for analysis or automation.
  • Strong communication and troubleshooting skills.
  • Comfortable working with existing systems and improving them incrementally.


Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, or risk data.
  • Experience with Airflow or other scheduled workflow tools.
  • AWS experience.
  • Observability/visualization experience (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior ClickHouse experience.
  • Basic Linux/CLI comfort.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Immigration Paralegal
description:
POSITION SPECIFICATION


Position Title: Immigration Paralegals

Reporting To: Operations Manager

Location: Remote (Preferred location: Rio de Janeiro), (telework), with the possibility of in-person work as required by the company.  

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US


HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.


POSITION SUMMARY

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
***Technical Business Analyst – 6 months+ - Brazil (Remote)***



We are currently supporting an international client who is looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst to join their team working on manufacturing and production IT systems.


This role acts as the key interface between business stakeholders and IT development teams , supporting the deployment, analysis, and improvement of systems such as ERP production

modules, MES, TPS, and SAP .



▶️ Start: ASAP

Duration: 6 months+

Location: Brazil - Remote

Language: English and Portuguese language skills



Key Responsibilities:


• Act as the interface between business users and development teams

• Support the analysis and improvement of manufacturing processes and systems

• Assist with system deployments, go-live, and user support

• Analyse incidents and change requests and assess their impact

• Translate business needs into functional requirements or user stories

• Support Agile delivery and user acceptance testing (UAT)



Key Requirements:


• Experience as a Technical Business Analyst or Functional Consultant

• Experience with manufacturing or production IT systems

• Knowledge of systems such as ERP (production modules), MES, SCM, WMS, or traceability solutions

• Experience working with business stakeholders and technical teams

• Experience in industrial environments (manufacturing, automotive, pharma, etc.)


Nice to have:


• SQL knowledge

• Experience within industrial sectors such as pharmaceuticals, automotive, aerospace, food production, or manufacturing



If you are interested in learning more, please apply with your latest CV and availability at

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

title: Web Designer
description:
Required Skills & Experience

*Experience writing and manipulating HTML

* Proficient in English, attentive to industry standards, and equipped with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Proficient with Figma for prototyping, sharing/testing designs

* Experience with utilizing a Design System

* Experience with front-end testing

*Experience working within a CMS to build webpages with components


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

*Experience in Adobe Creative suite (Photoshop)

* Experience contributing to a Design System

* Experience working with Adobe Experience Manager


Job Description

A BioTech client is seeking a Web Designer to join their team remotely in Brazil. This person will:

* Facilitate front-end content and code updates to the marketing website within Adobe Experience Manager

* Utilize brand guidelines and design system insights to build out new pages and experiences using existing code

* Collaborate closely with UX team to prototype intuitive experiences

* Source and manipulate imagery to create web-formatted graphics & banners

* Design layouts and templates for global solutions that focus on user experience

* Present design solutions to stakeholders and leadership

* Contribute to collaborative design sessions

* Support cross-browser testing at multiple stages of a project

* Evolve and build out the marketing site component and pattern libraries

** This role can pay up to $3,400 USD monthly

title: \"Analista de suporte Ecommerce Pleno #993094\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Atuar no suporte a incidentes envolvendo VTEX, Hub de Integração e ERP.
  • Realizar triagem e análise funcional/técnica inicial antes do escalonamento para Produto ou Desenvolvimento.
  • Abrir, acompanhar e encerrar tickets técnicos junto a fornecedores (VTEX, integrações, etc.), garantindo contexto, evidências e retorno aos solicitantes.
  • Analisar e interpretar logs, APIs e fluxos de integração, identificando falhas de processo, cadastro ou sistema.
  • Validar jornadas do usuário no front-end, identificando quebras, impactos no negócio e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Monitorar de forma proativa processos críticos do e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, impostos e cadastros).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de plataformas e parceiros.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação, evitando alinhamentos paralelos e respeitando os fluxos definidos.
  • Registrar recorrências e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais do e-commerce.
  • Apoiar a padronização de atendimentos, fluxos e documentação, contribuindo para a maturidade do suporte.


Experiência :

  • Conhecimento em VTEX (IO / FastStore).
  • Experiência com Hub de Integrações.
  • Capacidade de interpretação de logs e APIs REST (JSON, HTTP).
  • Noções de ITIL e processos de suporte.
  • Entendimento dos fluxos de e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, cadastros e cálculo de impostos).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados e acompanhamento de SLA.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas.


Valorizamos a diversidade e incentivamos a candidatura de profissionais de todos os perfis. Esta vaga é aberta a pessoas de diferentes gêneros, raças, orientações, idades, pessoas com deficiência e demais grupos.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Atuar no suporte a incidentes envolvendo VTEX, Hub de Integração e ERP.
  • Realizar triagem e análise funcional/técnica inicial antes do escalonamento para Produto ou Desenvolvimento.
  • Abrir, acompanhar e encerrar tickets técnicos junto a fornecedores (VTEX, integrações, etc.), garantindo contexto, evidências e retorno aos solicitantes.
  • Analisar e interpretar logs, APIs e fluxos de integração, identificando falhas de processo, cadastro ou sistema.
  • Validar jornadas do usuário no front-end, identificando quebras, impactos no negócio e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Monitorar de forma proativa processos críticos do e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, impostos e cadastros).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de plataformas e parceiros.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação, evitando alinhamentos paralelos e respeitando os fluxos definidos.
  • Registrar recorrências e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais do e-commerce.
  • Apoiar a padronização de atendimentos, fluxos e documentação, contribuindo para a maturidade do suporte.


Experiência :

  • Conhecimento em VTEX (IO / FastStore).
  • Experiência com Hub de Integrações.
  • Capacidade de interpretação de logs e APIs REST (JSON, HTTP).
  • Noções de ITIL e processos de suporte.
  • Entendimento dos fluxos de e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, cadastros e cálculo de impostos).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados e acompanhamento de SLA.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas.


Valorizamos a diversidade e incentivamos a candidatura de profissionais de todos os perfis. Esta vaga é aberta a pessoas de diferentes gêneros, raças, orientações, idades, pessoas com deficiência e demais grupos.

title: Product Designer
description:
OpenReplay is an open-source session replay and product analytics platform that helps businesses observe, measure and iterate on their web apps faster. We’re a well-funded startup, backed by some of the best angels and VCs around the world, including Y Combinator.


We’re looking for a talented Product Designer. You’ll be a key player in a small and highly-collaborative team, working closely with product and engineering to shape the future of our product and company.  


What you’ll do

  • Understand user behavior and translate that into intuitive and elevated product experiences
  • Own initiatives end-to-end and design flows, components and UI patterns
  • Create production-ready specs and functional high-fidelity interfaces
  • Communicate ideas through polished prototypes and compelling narratives
  • Collaborate with product and engineers by sharing work early and often to align on execution and outcomes
  • Shape our product vision through design explorations and presentations


What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of relevant design experience
  • Portfolio showcasing solid design foundations and beautiful interfaces
  • Proficiency with Figma and prototyping tools
  • Experience with HTML/CSS (JavaScript is a plus)
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive and self-starting mindset
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross functional teams and under pressure
  • Experience designing developer/technical products is a big plus

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Programa Jovem Aprendiz 2026
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.

Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.


Buscamos um(a) profissional que atuará: Jovem Aprendiz (Administrativo/Produção):

  • Auxiliar nas rotinas dos Departamentos;
  • Realizar atendimento, acompanhamento de relatórios, input de dados em sistema;
  • Atender outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao programa.


Quais são os requisitos imprescindíveis para essa vaga?

  • Ensino médio cursando ou completo
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office
  • Ter entre 18 e 22 anos


Nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Refeitório no local (para os dias presenciais no Complexo Butantan);
  • Vale Refeição (para os dias de treinamento externo);
  • Ônibus fretado - Instituto Butantan/ Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Descontos em parcerias de entretenimentos;
  • Ingressos para os museus do Butantan;
  • Totalpass – benefício focado na saúde e bem estar dos colaboradores;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e auto avaliação;
  • Participação em palestras e Workshops realizados no Butantan;
  • Mentoria;
  • Day Off de aniversário – O (a) Aprendiz terá direito a uma folga no mês do aniversário, acordado com a gestão.


Informações complementares:

Período de inscrições: 16/03/2026 a 30/03/2026

Quantidade de vaga(s): 60

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil

Horário de trabalho: 08h às 14h15 ou 12h às 18h15

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;
  • Entrevista com recrutadores;
  • Entrevista individual com o requisitante;
  • Entrevista individual com o gestor do requisitante.


Todas as etapas são eliminatórias e podemos indicar uma ou mais etapas a informar no processo seletivo.

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: Full Stack Developer Sênior (Plataforma)
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Sênior, com forte viés em backend , para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

Aqui, a Engenharia é tratada como cidadã de primeira classe: você terá voz ativa, participará das decisões estratégicas junto a Produto e Design e terá autonomia para propor e construir soluções.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs de produto e arquitetura


Desejável

  • Experiência com soluções financeiras ou fintech (pagamentos, billing, recorrência, webhooks)
  • Sólida base em System Design e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e)
  • Vivência em ambientes de startup de alto crescimento
  • Familiaridade com cultura DevOps


Modelo de Contratação

PJ


Oferecemos

  • Cartão flexível ajuda de custo R$265,00
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados)
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado
  • Rotina remota de trabalho
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
  • Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS)

  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);

  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;

title: Engenheiro Civil - Gestor de Obra
description:
Perfil Profissional

O candidato deve possuir perfil de liderança com foco em resultados e organização. É necessária proatividade, autoconfiança e ética, além de habilidades de negociação e persuasão para a gestão de pessoal, equipamentos e cumprimento de prazos.


Atividades e Responsabilidades

•Supervisão técnica de unidades, contratos e projetos sob sua responsabilidade.

•Planejamento de obras, controle de cronogramas e execução.

•Realização de Boletins de Medição de Obras e análise de resultados.

•Orçamentação de atividades/obras e análise de documentação técnica.

•Gestão de custos de obra vs. faturamentos e controle de despesas.

•Autorização de compra de materiais e requisição/desmobilização de equipamentos.

•Monitoramento técnico com proposição de ajustes em projetos para otimização de custos e zelo patrimonial.

•Domínio de rotinas administrativas pertinentes à função.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

•Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Civil com CREA ativo.

•Experiência: Atuação em obras públicas, preferencialmente com órgãos como DNIT, DER/ SEINFRA.

•Conhecimentos: em Terraplenagem, Pavimentação Betuminosa e Drenagens.

•Domínio: Excel avançado.

•Habilitação: CNH vigente.

•Mobilidade: Disponibilidade total para atuação em várias regiões, nomeadamente Norte e Sudeste.


Diferenciais

•Domínio dos softwares Sienge e Orçafascio.

Condições do Contrato

•Contratação PJ.


Interessados devem encaminhar o currículo para os e-mails:

e

O Grupo AG Capital possui uma sólida trajetória de resultados em compliance tributário. Listada entre as empresas que mais cresceram no Brasil em 2022 e 2023 (Rankings Deloitte e Revista Exame, PWC e BTG Pactual).

Profissionais experientes com mente empreendedora, postura de dono e atuação consultiva.

title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with both technical systems and non-technical users .
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and clear way.
  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior (PHP E VUE)
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack PHP/Vue Sr , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.

PJ

100% home office


Sobre a Posição:

Buscamos um desenvolvedor Full Stack experiente e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de tecnologia, focado na manutenção e evolução de sistema legado de alta demanda. O profissional ideal deve ter uma mentalidade orientada a soluções e disposição para trabalhar tanto com tecnologias frontend modernas e legadas quanto com diferentes versões do PHP em um ambiente tecnológico heterogêneo.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Backend

Sólida experiência com PHP, incluindo domínio das versões 5.6 e 7.0;

Proficiência em MySQL 5.6, incluindo otimização de queries e performance;

Experiência com Docker e containerização;

Domínio de Git e boas práticas de controle de versão;

Experiência com sistemas de cache, especialmente Redis;

Conhecimento desejável em Google Cloud Platform .


- Frontend

Experiência sólida com Vue.js e seus ecossistemas;

Domínio de JavaScript;

Experiência com jQuery em sistemas legados;

Conhecimento de HTML5 e CSS3;

Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.


Principais atividades:

- Manter e aprimorar sistema legado de alto tráfego;

- Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando Vue.js;

- Realizar a manutenção de códigos legados em jQuery;

- Implementar melhorias de performance e segurança;

- Realizar refatorações estratégicas mantendo a estabilidade do sistema;

- Colaborar na modernização gradual do código frontend e backend;

- Participar ativamente do planejamento técnico;

- Documentar alterações e processos técnicos;

- Mentor técnico para desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia com sistemas de alta demanda;

- Conhecimentos em práticas de CI/CD;

- Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis;

- Experiência em modernização gradual de sistemas legados;

- Conhecimento em arquitetura de software;

- Experiência com testes automatizados (PHPUnit, Jest);

- Conhecimentos em UI/UX e design responsivo.

O candidato ideal deve ser capaz de equilibrar a manutenção de código legado com a implementação gradual de melhorias, tanto no frontend quanto no backend, mantendo sempre a estabilidade do sistema em produção. Valorizamos profissionais que vejam sistemas legados como oportunidades de aprendizado e evolução tecnológica.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About Us :



Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In



You'll be a key player within the Sportingtech Team and joining a group of highly skilled professionals, with a pivotal responsibility in creating performing and scalable Java-based solutions across our award-winning iGaming Platform.



Who are You ?



As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.


Technologies Used:



Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace



The Impact you will have:



  • Software Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, and other stakeholders to design, develop, test, and deploy robust Java applications
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following best practices and coding standards. Also guide less senior engineers towards Test driven development.
  • Technical Analysis: Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues, providing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to aid in code understanding and future enhancements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including architects, developers, and QA’s, to deliver high-quality software in a timely fashion. Also mentor in different areas less experienced engineers.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify and implement performance enhancements, scalability improvements, and code optimizations.
  • Technology Stack: Stay up to date with the latest Java-related technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement the best solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Collaborate with the Team Lead to drive and standarise code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Security: Implement security best practices and contribute to maintaining the security of applications.
  • Agile Development: Embrace agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate project delivery.



What we’re looking for:




  • Strong experience with JDBC, JDBI or ORM tools
  • Practical experience and a strong grasp of Java concurrency
  • Development of distributed systems
  • High level proficiency and skills in at least one of the following technologies: AMQP, ZeroMQ, JMS, Kafka
  • Strong experience with MVC frameworks
  • Knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Understanding of principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Proficiency in backend development, including Rest API practice
  • Proficiency in principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Expert in creating automated unit and integration tests
  • Proficiency of multi-thread applications, OOP & MVC concepts and design patterns
  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems.




Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: ITSM Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.

Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Analytics Engineer - Sênior
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
  • Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Participa de iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Apoia e pareia com analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;


Diferencial

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelagens para IA em iniciativas de ML, copilots, agentes e observabilidade.


#SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

description:
Location: Remote (Americas preferred)

Type : Full Time Employment / Full Time Contractor

Department: Engineering – Platform & Database Operations

Company: Deep.BI


About Deep.BI

﻿Deep.BI provides consulting, enterprise support, and engineering services for open-source data infrastructure and real-time analytics platforms .

We help organizations design, deploy, migrate, and operate large-scale distributed data systems built on technologies such as:

  • Apache Druid
  • StarRocks
  • Apache Flink
  • Apache Kafka

title: Analista de Sistemas Sênior – Mobile e Integrações
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com forte atuação técnica em desenvolvimento mobile e integração de sistemas para atuar em um ambiente ágil, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares e apoiando na evolução das soluções tecnológicas da companhia.

O profissional terá papel ativo na definição de soluções técnicas, acompanhamento de fornecedores e garantia da qualidade das entregas de desenvolvimento.


Principais responsabilidades


Responsabilidades

  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis (Planning, Refinamento, Review e Retrospectiva).
  • Contribuir em processos de discovery, apoiando na definição de soluções técnicas.
  • Apoiar a evolução das aplicações mobile e integrações entre sistemas.
  • Acompanhar tecnicamente fornecedores e garantir a qualidade das entregas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade técnica para novas soluções e sistemas.
  • Apoiar na resolução de incidentes e demandas junto ao time de sustentação.
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa para garantir a integração e eficiência dos processos.
  • Participar de auditorias de TI e apoiar na melhoria contínua dos sistemas.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias tecnológicas.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico com o time.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Android, iOS ou Flutter)
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão com Git
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Squads / Tribos)
  • Experiência na análise e definição de soluções técnicas
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em Flutter
  • Experiência com Firebase
  • Vivência com MuleSoft
  • Conhecimento em Apache Kafka
  • Experiência com Oracle Database / PL-SQL
  • Conhecimento em C#
  • Familiaridade com Figma


Buscamos um profissional que tenha:

  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com diferentes áreas
  • Perfil colaborativo e trabalho em equipe
  • Organização e visão sistêmica
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas
  • Interesse em inovação e melhoria contínua


Atuação 100% remota

Contratação CLT.

title: AI Engineer
description:
OpenReplay is an open-source session replay and product analytics platform that helps businesses observe, measure and iterate on their web apps faster. We’re a well-funded startup, backed by some of the best angels and VCs around the world, including Y Combinator.


We’re looking for a talented AI Engineer. You’ll be a key player in a small and highly-collaborative team, working on the latest technologies, and directly shaping the future of our product and company.


What you’ll do

  • Design, build and maintain agents that learn from session replays and surface issues and recommendations for different personas
  • Collaborate closely with engineering to improve existing pipelines and implement context enrichment strategies that maximize outcome
  • Deliver production-ready features by leveraging existing pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, LLMs and orchestration frameworks
  • Partner with customers to turn impactful use cases into product features
  • Stay current with the latest advancements in LLMs, agent architectures and AI tooling


What we’re looking for

  • Proficiency in Python with proven ability to build product applications
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph)
  • Good knowledge of ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Familiarity with APIs, microservices and cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
  • Exposure to OLAP and vector databases (ClickHouse is a big plus)
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively and under pressure


Contact

Send your application to

title: Analista de RH Pleno | People Operations
description:
Somos uma gestora especializada em investimentos alternativos na América Latina. Nossos portfólios têm exposição a estratégias diversas, como VC, Growth, Buyout, Distress e nichos de mercado específicos onde haja alto potencial de retorno. Atualmente temos 6 fundos ativos, com investimentos primários, co-investimentos e secundários, somando um total de R$ 7 bilhões sob gestão.


Buscamos um(a) Analista de RH - People Operations para apoiar a execução das rotinas da área, garantindo organização, eficiência e conformidade nos processos de administração de pessoal, folha, benefícios e ciclo de vida do colaborador .


Como é o dia a dia?

• Executar e acompanhar rotinas de People Operations: folha de pagamento, admissões, desligamentos, férias, 13º salário, benefícios e segurança do trabalho;

• Analisar e validar cálculos e dados de folha, além de acompanhar indicadores de pessoas (turnover, movimentações e provisões);

• Atuar como ponto focal de benefícios, incluindo relacionamento com fornecedores e apoio em campanhas de saúde e bem-estar.

• Apoio no acompanhamento de indicadores de pessoas e orçamento da área

• Conduzir processos de onboarding e offboarding e apoiar iniciativas de RH, como treinamentos, pesquisas e eventos internos e offsites.

• Gestão e atualização de sistemas e bases de dados de RH e contribuir para melhorias de processos e automações.


O que buscamos?

• Graduação em Administração, Contabilidade, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência prévia em rotinas de People Operations / Administração de Pessoal , preferencialmente no mercado financeiro .

• Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista, folha de pagamento e benefícios .

• Excel avançado e bom domínio do pacote Office.

• Capacidade analítica para interpretação de dados, indicadores e relatórios de folha . Perfil analítico, organização e atenção a detalhes.

title: Pas-X System Owner
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for PAS-X System Owner .


In this role you will:

  • Stakeholder Engagement

Coordinate technical aspects of MES, including system interfaces, enhancements, and integration with IT infrastructure and engineering teams.

Act as the primary contact for MES-related activities: infrastructure deployment, systems integration, manufacturing intelligence, and support (tier 1/tier 2).

  • Roadmap Management

Manage and prioritize MES projects in partnership with business stakeholders (Manufacturing, Quality, IT).

Collaborate with global teams on MES initiatives, upgrades, and process improvements.

  • System Compliance:

Maintain MES system documentation, including SOPs, test cases, and technical specifications.

Ensure compliance with GxP, company policies, and Quality Management Systems (QMS).

Perform testing to demonstrate viability of solutions. Requires experience with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) procedures.

Support audits, CAPAs, and regulatory inspections related to PAS-X and manufacturing data integrity.

  • System Operations

Support electronic batch record (MBR) design, deployment, and troubleshooting.

Provide technical support for front-end and back-end PAS-X configuration (users, master data, printers, scales, terminals, etc.).

Oversee ServiceNow or equivalent ticketing system for MES incidents, changes, and escalations.

Deliver training and guidance to MES users and support personnel.

Engage and drive vendor support as required.


We have some requirements:

  • Knowledge of Korber Pharma Werum PAS-X MES
  • Knowledge of manufacturing and quality processes in GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) environments
  • Fluent English
  • SAP PP/PI and QM highly desirable


<<<< Please attach resume in English>>>>>>


What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform
  • Tata Consultancy Services is an equal opportunity employer, our commitment to diversity & inclusion drives our efforts to provide equal opportunity to all candidates who meet our required knowledge & competency needs, irrespective of any socio-economic background, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity/expression , age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation or any others. We encourage anyone interested to build a career in TCS to participate in our recruitment & selection process.



At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Desenvolvedor Senior Front-end React.js
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor Senior Front-end React.js para atuar em uma squad ágil orientada a fluxo (Kanban), responsável por construir e evoluir produtos digitais de alto impacto. O profissional trabalhará em parceria com Product Owner, UX/UI, back-end, QA e demais papéis do time, entregando para clientes internos e externos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com React.js (hooks, context, roteamento, estado, lifecycle).
  • Domínio de JavaScript ES6+ e TypeScript.
  • Familiaridade com Redux, Zustand, Recoil ou outros gestores de estado.
  • Conhecimento em HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Styled Components, CSS-in-JS.
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs REST ou GraphQL.
  • Ferramentas de build e empacotamento (Vite, Webpack, Babel).
  • Testes com Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress ou equivalentes.
  • Git, versionamento moderno e Git Flow (ou trunk-based com PRs).
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes ágeis (Kanban, Lean, Agile mindset).


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas, performáticas e responsivas utilizando React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript e o ecossistema associado.
  • Trabalhar em uma flow-based system com práticas de Kanban, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do fluxo de trabalho (WIP, lead time, cycle time, throughput, CFD).
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do time, como refinamentos, dailys, análises de fluxo e retrospectivas focadas em otimização de processo.
  • Colaborar com UX/UI para transformar protótipos e conceitos em experiências reais.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs e serviços back-end, garantindo padronização e qualidade técnica.
  • Realizar code reviews, apoiar na evolução da arquitetura front-end e garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Criar e manter testes (unitários, integração e E2E) para assegurar confiabilidade e estabilidade.
  • Atuar com mentalidade de ownership do produto, entendendo o impacto das entregas no negócio.
  • Colaborar com o Chapter de Front-end e Guildas técnicas, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.



O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil:
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita


Na TATA Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, trabalhamos sempre pela equidade. Isso se aplica em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com esses princípios. Pensamos em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social, a fim de construir uma TCS que respeita a individualidade. Seja um TCSer!

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
Job Title: Java Developer

Location: Brazil / Mexico / Costa Rica

Work Mode: Remote

Employment Type: Contract


Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Java Developer to join a dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Java 8+ , relevant frameworks (Spring, Hibernate ), relational databases, RESTful APIs, version control, and basic frontend knowledge. This role requires problem-solving, adaptability, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Responsibilities

  • Develop applications using Java 8+ and frameworks like Spring and Hibernate .
  • Apply strong object-oriented programming (OOP) principles.
  • Work with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL , and write optimized queries.
  • Build, maintain, and consume RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Use version control tools like Git for collaboration and code management.
  • Collaborate with frontend teams using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React .
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications.
  • Work with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence for task and project tracking.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and a dynamic work environment.
  • Communicate effectively with teams and stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • Proficiency in Java 8+ and frameworks (Spring, Hibernate, etc. )
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
  • Experience with relational databases (Oracle, MySQL, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs and web services
  • Experience with version control tools (Git)
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React )
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence
  • Ability to adapt and learn quickly in a dynamic environment


Desirable Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Familiarity with Agile / Scrum methodologies
  • Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Strong collaboration in cross-functional and remote teams


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in a relevant field
  • Technical certifications related to Java development are highly recommended

title: System Engineer Sr/IT-OT Integration
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for System Engineer Sr/IT-OT Integration .


In this role you will:

Install, commission, and integrate IT–OT environments in life sciences manufacturing. Blend hands-on industrial automation with secure networking, clear documentation, and cross functional collaboration.

  • Install, commission, and support IT-OT and related IT application solutions in production.
  • Develop and maintain UNIX shell and Windows scripts for automation and operations.
  • Configure secure industrial networks and OT→IT data flows; ensure reliability and compliance.
  • Connect platforms (Ignition, HiveMQ; HighByte advantageous) using OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus.
  • Design system architectures; produce clear installation/integration diagrams and runbooks.
  • Collaborate in agile teams; engage confidently with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Databases: Install, design and query across SQL and NoSQL stores; support historian connectivity.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; or equivalent practical experience.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture Documentation tools.
  • Strong analytical/problem solving and methodical troubleshooting.
  • Proactive, detail oriented team player in agile environments.

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products.
